sources.title: Aurora Machine Overview
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: El Capitan MI300A：共享記憶體與資料重用
related.titleEn: El Capitan MI300A: shared memory and reuse accounting
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付六裝置容量帳、存活區間與OOM證據表；兩個元素數吻合，bytes/GiB一致且峰值存活集合未超可用容量；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver six-device budgets, lifetime intervals and OOM evidence. Both counts match, bytes/GiB agree and peak live arrays fit usable capacity. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫CPU準備、GPU讀取及CPU消費的同一資料物件，分別標位址一致、可見性與快取流量；40/20毫秒下限重現，資料版本一致，流量與延遲證據分開。
related.differenceEn: Trace one object through CPU preparation, GPU reads and CPU consumption, separating address identity, visibility and traffic. Reproduce 40/20 ms bounds, match versions and separate traffic evidence from latency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 單裝置可供陣列使用容量M−R，b bytes/元素時可放floor((M−R)/b)元素；不可直接加總跨裝置容量；合成每裝置64GiB、保留8GiB、FP64 b8；改保留16GiB，並非Aurora實際規格；名義式 (64-8)*2**30/8 = 7516192768 elements/device；變更式 (64-16)*2**30/8 = 6442450944 elements/device。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
讀取B bytes、有效頻寬b bytes/s時理想下限T=B/b；快取重用可減少B但需實際證據；合成B=24GB、b=600GB/s；重用後只讀12GB，使用十進位GB；名義式 24/600 = 0.04 s；變更式 12/600 = 0.02 s。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: One device holds floor((M−R)/b) elements after reserve R; summing capacity does not remove partitioning requirements. Synthetic 64 GiB/device, reserve 8 GiB, FP64 b 8; compare reserve 16 GiB, not actual Aurora specifications. Nominal (64-8)*2**30/8 = 7516192768 elements/device; changed (64-16)*2**30/8 = 6442450944 elements/device. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Reading B bytes at effective bandwidth b gives lower bound T=B/b; cache reuse may reduce B but needs evidence. Synthetic B 24 GB, b 600 GB/s; reuse reduces reads to 12 GB, decimal GB. Nominal 24/600 = 0.04 s; changed 12/600 = 0.02 s. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SYCL：事件相依圖與臨界路徑
related.titleEn: SYCL: event dependencies and critical paths
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付六裝置容量帳、存活區間與OOM證據表；兩個元素數吻合，bytes/GiB一致且峰值存活集合未超可用容量；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver six-device budgets, lifetime intervals and OOM evidence. Both counts match, bytes/GiB agree and peak live arrays fit usable capacity. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫A→C、B→C兩邊，C等待兩個事件；標哪些資料由A/B產生；17/13正確，C絕不早於兩前驅完成且資料存活至最後消費。
related.differenceEn: Draw A→C and B→C, requiring both events and labeling producer data. Verify 17/13, C starts after both predecessors, and data survives its final consumer.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 單裝置可供陣列使用容量M−R，b bytes/元素時可放floor((M−R)/b)元素；不可直接加總跨裝置容量；合成每裝置64GiB、保留8GiB、FP64 b8；改保留16GiB，並非Aurora實際規格；名義式 (64-8)*2**30/8 = 7516192768 elements/device；變更式 (64-16)*2**30/8 = 6442450944 elements/device。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
獨立A與B完成後才做C，理想T=max(TA,TB)+TC；不同佇列不自動消除資料相依；合成A=8、B=12、C=5毫秒；變更B=6，其他不變且資源可平行；名義式 12+5 = 17 ms critical path；變更式 8+5 = 13 ms critical path。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: One device holds floor((M−R)/b) elements after reserve R; summing capacity does not remove partitioning requirements. Synthetic 64 GiB/device, reserve 8 GiB, FP64 b 8; compare reserve 16 GiB, not actual Aurora specifications. Nominal (64-8)*2**30/8 = 7516192768 elements/device; changed (64-16)*2**30/8 = 6442450944 elements/device. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Independent A/B precede C, so ideal T=max(TA, TB)+TC; separate queues do not remove dependencies. Synthetic A 8, B 12, C 5 ms; change B 6 with independent resources. Nominal 12+5 = 17 ms critical path; changed 8+5 = 13 ms critical path. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
